method: Full four source/UI files read and pinned Git blobs verified. Original onPlaylistProcessed function extracted with signature type erased and run under Node. Static inspection shows playlist error catch invokes this same completion handler.
findings: Playlist fetch failure catch logs error then calls normal completion handler, with default duplicates[] and processed=true. No error status is set in this path. Original handler control with final failed10-track model produces progress100,toProcess0 and library_processed event. Full browser pipeline not executed.

Owned-playlist fetch catch logs but returnsundefined; subsequent .map assumes array. Saved-track first page is fetched twice and first total drives progress, so changing snapshots can change denominator. Empty-library total0 can produce NaN progress. Source-only observations.

Module-global cache stores snapshot_id->v1 in localStorage. Namespace/user/playlist/policy not part of key; entries never expire/evict in this class. Cache hit creates fresh empty duplicate model and marks processed without rereading tracks. Snapshot identity is domain-specific, not file content proof.

UI duplicate row distinguishes same-id from same-name-artist with localized badge. It displays track/artist through react-i18next Trans interpolation; pixel rendering, escaping behavior and translation resources not evaluated by source reading.
Duplicate list wrapper is plain children in ul; completion/error classification belongs elsewhere, so no claim of actual final user-visible warning without remaining components.
